title: Master Contract Article: Renewal and Renewal Rating of Employer Group Contracts
content:
**Article R. Renewal.** An Employer Group Contract in the Cascade Group Dental & Vision series renews on its anniversary with renewal rates and plan choices for the new plan year, on the following terms.

R.1 Renewal rates are sent the segment's renewal notice period before the renewal date and take effect on it for the segment's rate guarantee from a renewal.

R.2 No increase exceeds the segment's renewal rate cap.

R.3 Rates do not change during a guarantee; the segment schedule does not allow mid-term rate changes.

R.4 A group offering both Cascade dental and vision receives the segment's dental-vision bundle discount off both rates.

R.5 Renewal rates follow the segment's pooling level, with the group's own claims experience used only when the segment schedule shows that experience rating applies.

R.6 The vision member-and-spouse rate is the member-only vision rate multiplied by the vision member-and-spouse ratio, and the vision member-and-children rate is the member-only vision rate multiplied by the vision member-and-children ratio, each rounded half up to the cent. The ratios are 1.9 for member and spouse and 2.0 for member and children in every segment.

R.7 Plan choices for the new plan year are made at open enrollment and take effect on the renewal date.

## Per-segment figures applied by this article

| Segment | Renewal rate cap | Dental-vision bundle discount |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | 12 percent | 0 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | 12 percent | 2 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 10 percent | 3 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | 10 percent | 3 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 8 percent | 4 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | 8 percent | 5 percent |

## What a renewal records

A renewal records the dental plan and the vision plan for the new plan year, the renewal rates for the four dental tiers and for the member-only and family vision tiers, the next anniversary as the new renewal date, and the end of the renewal rate guarantee.

## Worked illustration of R.6 (hypothetical rate)

| Item | Working | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Member-only vision rate | hypothetical input | 9.45 dollars |
| Member-and-spouse vision rate | 9.45 dollars multiplied by 1.9 gives 17.955 dollars, rounded half up to the cent | 17.96 dollars |
| Member-and-children vision rate | 9.45 dollars multiplied by 2.0 gives 18.90 dollars | 18.90 dollars |

## Points of judgement

- **When do renewal rates start to apply?** On the renewal date, and they then hold for the segment's rate guarantee from a renewal.
- **Does a group's own claims experience enter its renewal rates?** Only when the segment schedule shows that experience rating applies; otherwise renewal rates follow the segment's pooling level without it.
- **Which groups receive the bundle discount?** A group offering both Cascade dental and vision, and the discount comes off both the dental and the vision rates.
- **When does a plan chosen at open enrollment take effect?** On the renewal date.
